rows.evidence: The shared handler calls recorder.stop() whenever AppLifecycleState.inactive; it is now used by voice attachments.
rows.next_step: Define foreground/background recording behavior, separate focus, visibility and actual audio interruption, and serialize stop/finalize/recovery. Test notification shade, permission UI, another focused multi-window app and lock/resume.
rows.reason: Source-level lifecycle mistake: inactive can mean visible without focus on both targets. An incidental focus change must not silently truncate/discard an attachment; blanket hidden-only handling is also insufficient.

device_plan.expected: Visible text/caret/actions and correct hit bounds throughout; stable draft/selection/focus/session. Record logical sizes, display/text scales, monitor configuration and captures.
